en.headline: Reported drug abusers fall 9pc in first half of 2026
en.dek: Central Registry figures show 2,688 reported abusers, down from 2,955 a year earlier; youth under 21 also declined while etomidate remains the main drug among young people.
body: The total number of reported drug abusers in Hong Kong fell by 9 per cent in the first half of 2026 compared with the same period last year, the Action Committee Against Narcotics noted at its meeting on Tuesday.

Figures from the Central Registry of Drug Abuse showed 2,688 reported abusers between January and June, down from 2,955 in the first half of 2025. Heroin, methamphetamine (Ice) and cocaine were the three most commonly reported drugs. Among those aged under 21 the number fell from 458 to 404, with etomidate remaining the most common drug in that age group, followed by cannabis and cocaine.

Law enforcement data for the same period recorded a 10 per cent drop in persons arrested for drug offences, from 1,938 to 1,749. Young arrestees under 21 declined by 3 per cent to 298. The conviction rate in concluded court cases involving drug offences stood at 87 per cent. More than half of young offenders jailed for trafficking received sentences of over five years, the longest being 28 years.

ACAN chairman Dr Donald Li said prevention programmes for communities, schools and families help ensure young people grow up free from drugs. The Narcotics Division said it has expanded outreach to kindergarten and primary pupils and young parents this year, using interactive games and community events rather than purely deterrent messaging.

zh.headline: 上半年被呈報吸毒人數跌9% 青少年組別亦下降
zh.dek: 檔案室數字顯示上半年2,688人被呈報，按年減少，21歲以下由458人降至404人，依托咪酯仍是青少年最常吸食毒品。
body: 禁毒常務委員會今日（9月15日）舉行會議，備悉藥物濫用資料中央檔案室二○二六年上半年統計數字。整體被呈報吸毒人數較二○二五年同期下跌9%。
檔案室數字顯示，上半年被呈報吸毒人數由2,955人下降至2,688人。海洛英、甲基安非他明（冰毒）和可卡因是最常被呈報的三類毒品。21歲以下青少年被呈報人數由458人降至404人，該組別中依托咪酯繼續是最常被吸食的毒品，其次為大麻及可卡因。
執法部門統計顯示，上半年涉毒品罪行被捕人數按年跌10%，由1,938人降至1,749人；21歲以下被捕青少年跌3%至298人。同期審結的毒品案件定罪率達87%。因販毒被判監禁的21歲以下青少年中，超過半數刑期超過五年，最長達28年。
禁常會主席李國棟醫生表示，社區、學校和家庭的預防計劃有助年輕一代遠離毒品。保安局禁毒處表示，今年起加強以幼稚園、小學學童及年輕家長為對象的社區參與活動，以輕鬆互動方式推廣禁毒知識。
